title: Native model picker protocol
responsibility: Normalizes protocol objects and identifies the provider for supported native picker model selections.

inputs.name: nativePickerProtocol.value
inputs.description: Unknown protocol value to retain only when it is a non-null, non-array object.

inputs.name: pickerProvider.model
inputs.description: Selected model value; exact claude-opus-5-5 uses the experimental gateway, other claude-prefixed or nonstring values are rejected.

outputs.name: nativePickerProtocol
outputs.description: Original object cast as protocol data, or a new empty object for other values.

outputs.name: pickerProvider
outputs.description: harness-claude for claude-opus-5-5; openai for other strings not beginning claude-.

outputs.name: nativeOpusModel
outputs.description: Catalog entry for nondefault Claude Opus 5.5 through Harness, with xhigh effort, text/image input and an experimental hosted-web-search limitation.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown for a nonstring selection or any other claude-prefixed model.
